tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background — unbleached silk by day, wine-dark stone by night. Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Post cards, code blocks, nav pill, any stitched patch that sits on the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet washes: callouts, tag fills, inline code, hover rows.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Footer and other terminal bands. Text on it uses on-deep / on-deep-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, titles, high-emphasis text on every surface-* except surface-deep. 13:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Body copy and paragraph text on canvas, card and tint. The workhorse text color — warm plum, never grey.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, reading time, captions, helper copy on canvas, card and tint (4.8:1+).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Sirene's rose. THE one action color: primary button fill, active nav, link text. Text-safe on canvas, card and tint in both themes.

tokens.name: on-rose
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rose fill (5.8:1 silk, 8.3:1 coliseum).

tokens.name: rose-blush
tokens.usage: Selection highlight, hovered tag, the blush band of the hero ribbon. Decorative ground only.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Decorative: embroidery florets, ribbon stripes, cover blocks. Never text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Gold leaf as text: eyebrow labels, the italic accent word in a headline, numbered list markers. 4.6:1+ on canvas, card and tint.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Gold thread for seams: dashed stitch lines, stitched card borders, rug fringe. 3.7:1 on canvas — for marks, not body text.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The sea beyond the coliseum. Secondary accent: code keywords, 'note' callouts, outlined secondary links. Text-safe on canvas, card and tint.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Plain 1px dividers and card outlines where a stitched seam would be too busy (tables, form fields).

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Headings and links on surface-deep.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-deep (7:1+).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Same as rose; 3:1+ on all surfaces.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home hero and article titles on wide screens. One per page. The italic accent word goes in gold.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section titles, article H2, display on phones.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A slow read about fast systems.
styles.usage: Standfirst under an article title; hero paragraph.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Long-form prose sits at 18px with a 66-character measure.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, tag labels, meta rows. Always uppercase, always tracked.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and inline code (inline at 0.88em).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Stitch gap, icon-to-label nudge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, meta row gap, stitched-border inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Element gap; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap between post cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap above an article H2.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section gap on desktop — the slow, gallery rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, small chips inside text.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, code blocks, callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Post cards and other stitched patches.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, the floating nav.

tokens.name: shadow-patch
tokens.usage: A sewn patch lifting off cloth: post cards, nav pill. The only shadow.
